text:
ana: Heads-up: planning a soft reboot + NIC firmware flush in az26 tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Target pool = saturn-gpu-3. Rolling drain in cohorts, ~30m per cohort. Backfill + KV cache priming after each cohort. Will keep hosted capacity >=60%. :spiral_calendar:

tyler: ETA for total window? how many cohorts?

ana: total ~= 4 cohorts, so ~2.5-3h end-to-end including priming. Canary first (2 nodes), then 3 cohorts of ~8 nodes each.

nina: can we tag the canary nodes and run the smoke runbook before draining the rest? i'll own smoke.

ana: yes — canary label = saturn-gpu-3/canary=true. smoke checklist: `curl -s https://health/saas | jq .status` and a short perf test (see snippet below).

ana: ```
# smoke perf (3 runs, 128 tokens)
python tools/perf_test.py --model redwood-v2 --node-tag canary --tokens 128 --runs 3
```

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance ticket created: MAINT-az26-2026-03-04. Notifying oncall. :white_check_mark:

samir: budget/cost question — if we backfill with burst capacity, any extra spend to flag?

ana: estimate: ~3 GPU-hours of burst across cohorts (we'll prefer warm spare nodes). Rough cost ~$120 gross; i'll add a line item to the ticket.

mike: rollback plan if firmware causes perf regression?

ana: rollback steps pinned to ticket, short version: 
```
# rollback
kubectl uncordon <node> --context az26
ansible-playbook -i inventory/az26 revert-nic-fw.yml --limit <cohort>
move traffic back via routing rollback: /ops/scripts/egress_swap.sh --from=backup --to=primary
```

ana: We'll also keep a short retention window of metrics (30m resolution) for 2h post-cohort to detect regressions quickly.

nina: i'll run the smoke and post results in this thread. if anything >10% p99 latency bump -> abort.

mike: recommend enabling canary routing rule: route 2% traffic to canary during test. low blast.

ana: good call. i'll add route rule.

pagerduty: Oncall (eve) assigned: @tyler. PagerDuty alert policy attached: MAINT-az26-critical.

tyler: i'll be oncall for the window. plan to monitor the host metrics dashboard + token-level tail. set slack alert if p99 crosses threshold.

ana: final runbook snippet (short):
```
T-60m: announce in #eng-infra and #support
T-30m: cordon canary nodes
T-25m: perform canary firmware flush + soft reboot
T-20m: run smoke perf and health checks
T-10m: if OK -> start cohort 1 drain
T+30m per cohort: uncordon backfilled nodes and kv priming
```

samir: cool. please add an opt-out list for reserved customers (we should avoid draining capacity from pinned pools).

ana: will do — reserved pools excluded. I'll post final start time and ticket link in 1h. :thumbsup:
